title: Canonical counit-normalized transport of completed strict pullback
statement: Let $(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and let $f:S\to T$ be a morphism of schemes. Compare the objectwise K-flat total left derived completed strict tower pullback $Lf^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] with the exact derived termwise module pullback $f^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}$ along the same completed coefficient map [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], as in [def-weil-pbc-exact-pullback-interface]. The ordinary strict tower functors are identified by equality of the completed coefficient structure maps, hence so are their functors on cochain complexes. Define $t_f:Lf^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}\simeq f^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}$ to be the unique natural isomorphism whose localization on cochain complexes intertwines the universal K-flat resolving counit with the ordinary exact-derived factorization, after this specified identification of ordinary functors. Thus this transport retains the universal counit on every cochain representative, all quotient transitions and all degrees. It is not a choice from an unconstrained existence assertion; uniqueness fixes the transport. No completeness, open immersion or cohomological bound is required.
